actions.description: Enable the trigger and start acquisition (the native run, :RUN)
actions.name: run_acquisition

outputs.description: Acquisition state reported after the native run returned
outputs.name: acquire_state

actions.description: Disable the trigger and stop acquisition (the native stop, :STOP); it takes no input
actions.name: stop_acquisition

outputs.description: Acquisition state reported after the native stop returned
outputs.name: acquire_state

actions.description: Force a trigger event (the native force_trigger, TRIG FORC)
actions.name: force_trigger

outputs.description: Trigger state reported after the forced trigger event
outputs.name: trigger_state

actions.description: Send a SCPI software trigger event (the inherited native trigger, *TRG)
actions.name: software_trigger

outputs.description: Trigger state reported after the software trigger event
outputs.name: trigger_state

actions.description: Reset the instrument (the inherited native reset, *RST); it may revert all settings
actions.name: reset_instrument

outputs.description: True after the native reset returned
outputs.name: reset

facts.text: TekDPO70000 is a multi-channel oscilloscope with analog bandwidths ranging up to 33 GHz
acquire_enhanced_enob reads and writes ACQ:ENHANCEDE and its documented values are AUTO and OFF
acquire_enhanced_state reads and writes ACQ:ENHANCEDE:STATE as a boolean
acquire_interp_8bit reads and writes ACQ:INTERPE and its documented values are AUTO, ON and OFF
acquire_magnivu reads and writes ACQ:MAG as a boolean
acquire_mode reads and writes ACQ:MOD using the AcquisitionMode values
acquire_mode_actual is the read-only ACQ:MOD:ACT acquisition mode
acquire_num_acquisitions is the read-only ACQ:NUMAC count of acquisitions since ACQuire:STATE RUN
acquire_num_avgs reads and writes ACQ:NUMAV, the number of waveform acquisitions to average
acquire_num_envelop reads and writes ACQ:NUME, the number of waveform acquisitions to be enveloped
acquire_num_frames is the read-only ACQ:NUMFRAMESACQ count of frames acquired in FastFrame mode
acquire_state reads and writes ACQ:STATE and starts or stops acquisitions
trigger_state reads TRIG:STATE and reports the TriggerState
force_trigger sends TRIG FORC to force a trigger event
run sends :RUN to enable the trigger
stop sends :STOP to disable the trigger
reset sends *RST and may revert all settings to their defaults
trigger sends *TRG, a software trigger event
